document: DS13560 Rev 6 - Table 88. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position
title: Table 88. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position
text_helper: Table 88. WLCSP52 - Tolerance of form and position — section 1.2 REF. Symbol(1), Millimeters / Min, Millimeters / Typ, Millimeters / Max, Inches(2) / Typ, +2 autres.

notes: 1. Dimensioning and tolerancing schemes are conform to ASME Y14.5M-2018 apart European projection.
2. Values in inches are converted from millimeters and rounded to four decimal digits.
3. The profile height, A, is the distance from the seating plane to the highest point on the package. It is measured perpendicular to the seating plane.
4. A1 is defined as the distance from the seating plane to the lowest point on the package body for CSP or the distance from the seating plane to the land for CSP.
5. Measured at the maximum size of the terminal (ball, land) in a plane parallel to datum C.
6. BSC stands for basic dimensions. It corresponds to the nominal value and has no linear tolerance.
